narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On July 9, 2024, at approximately 1115 hours, Border Patrol Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] responded to a request from the Michigan State Police at a traffic stop near Port Huron, Michigan. The driver, later identified as the subject, stated that he is a citizen of Nigeria and presented a Nigerian passport containing a B1/B2 visa. Records checks showed that the subject was admitted at John F. Kennedy International Airport on March 2, 2016, as a B2 visitor authorized to remain until September 1, 2016. The subject stated that he stayed after his authorized period to work and has not applied for any other status. Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] arrested the subject at approximately 1130 hours.
DISPOSITION:
The subject was served a Notice to Appear and detained pending removal proceedings.
